class.name: TrenchbroomMap
class.brief_description: Builds a 3D scene from Quake MAP or Valve VMF files using Blazium Trenchbroom map settings.
class.description: TrenchbroomMap parses map files, generates brush geometry, and assembles entity nodes according to [BlaziumFGDFile] definitions.

method.name: build
method.description: Parses the configured map file and builds child nodes.

method.name: clear_children
method.description: Removes all child nodes from this map node.

members.member: Bitmask of [enum BuildFlags] options applied during [method build].
Absolute or UID path to a MAP or VMF file outside the project.
Size of the oversized clipping plane used during brush CSG face generation.
Path to a project-local MAP or VMF file.
Map build settings including FGD definitions and texture paths.

signal.name: build_complete
signal.description: Emitted when map build completes successfully.

signal.name: build_progress
signal.description: Emitted during map build with the current step name and progress from 0 to 1.

constants.constant: Generates UV2 lightmap coordinates during build.
Disables smooth shading on generated meshes.
Includes Hammer cordon volumes in the build output.
